paragraphs: Chagra, brother of Rabbi Ba bar Buna, gave a Torah scroll to Rav Chananel: Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah 1:11. Rabbi Yose recited: those of the house of Chagira were skilled scribes in Jerusalem. Abba Chalfi in the name of Abba Chagra his father: Derekh Eretz chapter 1.
